item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
Youth-led Cockroach Janta protests continue across India with the party leader arrested as security forces intensify the crackdown. In Manipur Kuki-Zo groups and a women’s forum have demanded President's Rule while Congress blames the BJP for governance failure and houses were torched in an abandoned village amid ethnic tensions. The Ekta Diwas parade will feature 2,000 artists from 126 Naxal-hit districts with Prime Minister Modi attending. A bus plunged into a deep gorge in Udhampur, killing two and injuring fifteen. 437 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
